name: chief-team-small
tagline: Your AI-powered C-suite, six chiefs deep.
description: Six executive chiefs — CEO, COO, CFO, CMO, CTO, and CPO — working together as an agentic team to advise on strategy, operations, finance, marketing, technology, and people. The CEO orchestrates the other five as direct reports in a flat hierarchy, sharing objectives, context and memory the same way every Quox agentic team does.
shortDescription: 6-chief AI executive suite for small businesses.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: 6 coordinated executive chiefs: CEO, COO, CFO, CMO, CTO, CPO
CEO orchestrator delegates to five direct-report specialists
Shared objectives, context and memory across the team
Topology health monitoring and automatic fallback routing
